hypotheses.cause: Dense short timed ASR fragments make metadata dominate source batches.
hypotheses.fix: Lossless shared source-unit grouping for >=128short timed fragments, <=256characters and15seconds per group. Original characters and every real time anchor preserved. No source batch limit raised. Explicit grouped ID namespace; legacy candidates resume original IDs.
hypotheses.boundary: Real quality and provider-call savings require full-episode acceptance, not merely grouping counts.
hypotheses.final_review: Single-mode generation now gets a single whole-source final review, matching the existing whole-source generation/initial-review context. Only an explicit provider capacity error permits one bounded partitioned fallback; valid rejection, malformed check and transport errors never trigger repartition. Segmented-mode final review remains bounded and parallel<=2. All source lines and final prose are checked.

hypotheses.cause: Local source correction re-evaluates unrelated positive coverage against the whole changed draft, causing cost and possible reviewer variance.
hypotheses.fix: Positive coverage certificates require unchanged source/model/options/obligation and exact cited factual prose/provenance plus complete local chapter wording/order and overview. Renderer media annotations and outer chapter container indices do not invalidate factual support. Changed local qualifications invalidate the whole local chapter. All negative receipts remain rechecked; every changed whole draft requires final independent source review. Previously covered obligations guide source correction as untrusted data.
hypotheses.synthetic: 20covered obligations,1changed paragraph:19stable certificates reused and only changed item matched; changed item remains missing. Source/model/overview changes invalidate all. Added whole-draft contradiction still blocks.
hypotheses.semantic_preservation_gate: Before applying a source correction, independently check every previously covered obligation linked to its paragraphs against original source and the entire proposed draft. Retain every source-supported material meaning. On validated loss, use only the existing second local-edit opportunity, with specific missing obligations as feedback; validate again. Still missing or malformed evidence blocks replacement. No old obligation is deleted,reclassified or marked covered by this guard; source errors are not forced into prose. Candidate changes are atomic and an unsafe old paragraph is never published as fallback.
hypotheses.contradiction_source_authority: Before changing prose to resolve a checklist contradiction, verify that obligation against primary source. Correct a false source statement and rematch the unchanged draft; retain a source-affirmed contradiction for real paragraph repair. Never compress away a contradicted obligation as incidental background. If its source validation failed, an unverified checklist cannot authorize rewriting prose; independent raw-source correction remains available.

hypotheses.cause: Matcher duplicate flag for existing prose is treated as missing/unverified coverage, although duplicate judges novelty of proposed additions.
hypotheses.fix: For no proposed paragraphs only, record existing redundancy and normalize proposal-duplicate flag. Grounding rejection, contradiction, raw fallback and new duplicate-proposal vetoes remain.
hypotheses.boundary: Old two unverified items may fit this mechanism; their exact old failure messages were not retained, so historical attribution is unproven.

hypotheses.cause: After a source correction makes coverage insufficient, an immutable whole-draft review is spent before known necessary coverage edits, then repeated after them.
hypotheses.fix: After source correction, use the one existing bounded coverage-repair opportunity before final whole-draft review. Keep source-first ordering when source safety is still unknown. Skip final review only when delivery is already impossible; never publish without final source review. Original three iterations and repair limits retained.
hypotheses.synthetic: Source repair -> matching -> coverage repair -> one final review; initially unknown unsupported prose still receives preliminary source review before correction.
hypotheses.immutable_scope_fix: Organize repaired chapters before final review, not after it. Final-review identity now includes chapter headings and paragraph order; unchanged text under a changed scope cannot reuse an old pass.

real_validation.additional_quality_control: After core acceptance, independently match every frozen same-source archived obligation. Losslessly translate ranges; no item deletion/correction/materiality change or prose repair. Report core latency/HTTP separately from independent checklist validation and optional failure samples. A failing independent check keeps the test unaccepted.
real_validation.capture: Original rejected wording and final candidate in RAM; bounded2call sampling on failure; cleared before exit. Fixed-label check failure causes, rewrite sizes and changed-support regressions retained as aggregates.
